rationale: The message explains an algorithm/approach for HCL block parsing and notes an implementation detail about hcldump, so its main function is proposing a design/fix. It also clarifies the intended structure for blocks and repeated unlabeled blocks.

evidence.text: Block algorithm: tokenize `{}` recursively; each block header tokens before `{` (ident + quoted labels), convert d[base] list; for each label nest list until final dict attrs.
Existing hcldump emits maps as quoted key = {}, while ref -jc does same for JSON maps.
